mapper.select:
SELECT a.userId,a.alarmLocation,a.customerCode,a.customerName,a.tenantManager,
a.isOperation, a.operationModifier, a.operationModifierDate,
a.province_id,a.provinceName,a.city_id,a.cityName,a.isOpen,a.apiCreateTime,a.apiCreateBy,a.devNum,a.orderNum,a.validOrderNum, a.openModifier,a.openModifierDate, case when a.isOpen = '1' then '开启' else '未开启' end isOpenName, max(a.cascadeStatus) cascadeStatus, max(a.cascadeModifier) cascadeModifier, max(a.cascadeModifierName) cascadeModifierName, max(a.cascadeModifierDate) cascadeModifierDate, a.login_type, a.login_url FROM ( SELECT u.user_id as userId, tenant.tenant_id AS customerCode, tenant.tenant_name AS customerName, u.USER_NAME AS tenantManager,
IFNULL(stoc.is_operation,0) AS isOperation, stoc.modifier as operationModifier, DATE_FORMAT(stoc.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') as operationModifierDate,
tenant.alarm_location as alarmLocation, tenant.province_id, area1.area_name AS provinceName, tenant.city_id, area2.area_name AS cityName, IFNULL( register.is_open, '0' ) AS isOpen, IFNULL( register.create_time, '' ) AS apiCreateTime, IFNULL( register.create_by, '' ) AS apiCreateBy, 0 as devNum, 0 as orderNum, 0 as validOrderNum, register.open_modifier as openModifier, DATE_FORMAT(register.open_modifier_date,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') as openModifierDate, tenant.is_cascade as cascadeStatus, tenant.cascade_modifier as cascadeModifier, casu.nick_name as cascadeModifierName, tenant.cascade_modifier_date as cascadeModifierDate, tenant.login_type, tenant.login_url FROM sys_tenant_info tenant LEFT JOIN sys_area area1 ON tenant.province_id = area1.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area area2 ON tenant.city_id = area2.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_auth_register_api register ON tenant.tenant_id = register.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.tenant_id = tenant.tenant_id and u.is_tenant_admin=1 and u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_user casu ON casu.user_name = tenant.cascade_modifier and casu.del_flag = '0'
left join sys_tenant_operation_config stoc on tenant.tenant_id = stoc.tenant_id
where tenant.del_flag = '0'
AND stoc.is_operation in
#{labelIdItem}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vm_order_customer o WHERE o.tenant_id = tenant.tenant_id AND o.accept_node = #{locationCode})
${dataScope}
group by tenant.tenant_id ,stoc.accept_node,stoc.industry_code,stoc.app_ver_code,stoc.is_operation
) a
and a.province_id = #{provinceId}
and (a.city_id = #{cityId} or a.province_id = #{cityId})
and a.tenantManager like concat('%',#{tenantManager},'%')
and a.customerCode = #{customerCode}
and a.customerCode
NOT
IN ( SELECT DISTINCT oc.tenant_id FROM vm_order_customer oc WHERE oc.ord_status IN ('0', '1', '2') AND oc.delete_flag = '0' )
and a.isOpen = #{isOpen}
AND a.customerCode not in ( select distinct stoc.tenant_id from sys_tenant_operation_config stoc where stoc.is_operation = '1' )
and a.openModifier like concat('%',#{openModifier},'%')
AND a.openModifierDate >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{openModifierDateStart}, ' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
AND a.openModifierDate <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{openModifierDateEnd}, ' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
and a.operationModifier like concat('%',#{operationModifier},'%')
AND a.operationModifierDate >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{operationModifierDateStart}, ' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
AND a.operationModifierDate <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{operationModifierDateEnd}, ' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
AND a.customerCode in
#{labelIdItem}
and a.cascadeStatus = #{cascadeStatus}
and (a.cascadeModifier like concat('%',#{cascadeModifier},'%') or a.cascadeModifierName like concat('%',#{cascadeModifier},'%'))
AND a.cascadeModifierDate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{cascadeModifierDateStart},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
AND a.cascadeModifierDate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{cascadeModifierDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
and a.customerCode in ( SELECT DISTINCT oc.tenant_id FROM vm_order_customer oc WHERE oc.ord_status IN ('0', '1', '2') AND oc.delete_flag = '0' )
group by a.customerCode order by a.cascadeModifierDate desc,a.openModifierDate desc,a.userId DESC

SELECT tenant.tenant_id AS customerCode, tenant.tenant_name AS customerName FROM sys_tenant_info tenant where tenant.del_flag = '0' ${dataScope} group by tenant.tenant_id ORDER BY
CASE WHEN tenant.tenant_id IN
#{item}
THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
tenant.update_time DESC, tenant.tenant_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_auth_register_api (id,tenant_id, tenant_name, app_key, secret_key, is_open, create_time, delete_flag,create_by,open_modifier,open_modifier_date ) VALUES (#{id},#{customerCode}, #{customerName}, #{appKey}, #{secretKey}, #{isOpen}, now(), '1', #{createBy}, #{openModifier}, now() );

mapper.select: SELECT callback_url AS "callbackUrl" FROM sys_auth_register_api reg LEFT JOIN sys_auth_register_func_api func ON reg.id = func.register_id WHERE reg.is_open = '1' AND reg.tenant_id = #{customerCode} AND func.delete_flag = '1' AND func.`type` = #{type}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_history_logs_api (`type`,url,original_json,request_json,response_json, create_time,expend_time,status,error, tenant_id) VALUES (#{type},#{url}, #{originalJson},#{requestJson},#{responseJson}, now(),#{expendTime},#{status},#{error},#{customerCode})

( #{alarmTypeReqVo.tenantId}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.operationType}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.alarmSource}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.operationAlarmTypeStr}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.deleteFlag}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.modifier}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.modifier}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.updateTime}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.isOperation}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.acceptNode}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.industryCode}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.appVerCode}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.operationNode}, #{alarmTypeReqVo.operationDept} )

SELECT a.tenant_id, a.tenant_name, b.user_name as tenant_manager FROM sys_tenant_info a left JOIN sys_user b on a.tenant_id=b.tenant_id and b.is_tenant_admin=1 WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.del_flag = '0'

SELECT DISTINCT c.order_code,c.ord_status,c.order_time,c.subscriber_name as subscriber,c.valid_time,c.invalid_time,c.tenant_id as customer_code FROM vm_order_customer c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{custCode} ORDER BY c.valid_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT f.function_type, f.function_type_name, f.sub_function_type, f.sub_function_type_name, f.function_code, f.function_code_name, fa.algorithm_code, fa.algorithm_name FROM vm_algorithm_info_t fa LEFT JOIN vm_function_type f ON fa.function_code = f.function_code WHERE fa.delete_flag = '0' AND f.delete_flag = '0'

select * from ( select o.tenant_id,t.tenant_name,o.`accept_node` as locationCode,c.`platform_name` as locationName, o.industry_code,
d.industry_name,
o.app_ver_code,count(o.accept_node) as locationOrderNum, 0 as locationValidOrderNum, 0 as locationValidDevNum, 0 as isOperation, '未开启' as isOperationName, IFNULL(s.is_open,0) as thirdAlarmStatus, case when s.is_open = 1 then '开启' else '未开启' end thirdAlarmStatusName, IFNULL(s.modifier,'') as thirdAlarmModifier, IFNULL(s.update_time,'') as thirdAlarmModifierDate, c.general_url AS generalUrl, c.program_url AS programUrl from vm_order_customer o left join `vm_platform_data_config` c on o.`accept_node` = c.`platform_code` and c.`delete_flag` = 0
left join sys_industry_conf d on d.industry_code = o.industry_code and d.accept_node = o.accept_node and d.delete_flag= '0'
left join sys_tenant_info t on t.tenant_id = o.tenant_id left join sys_tenant_third_alarm_config s on o.tenant_id = s.tenant_id and o.accept_node = s.accept_node and o.industry_code = s.industry_code and o.app_ver_code = s.app_ver_code and s.delete_flag = '0' where o.delete_flag = 0 and o.tenant_id in
#{item}
and o.accept_node = #{param.currentLocationCode}
and o.ord_status in ('0', '1', '2')
GROUP BY o.tenant_id,locationCode,o.industry_code ,o.app_ver_code order by o.tenant_id ) a
and (a.tenant_id like concat('%',#{param.tenantId},'%') or a.tenant_name like concat('%',#{param.tenantId},'%'))
and (a.locationCode like concat('%',#{param.locationCode},'%') or a.locationName like concat('%',#{param.locationCode},'%'))
and (a.industry_code like CONCAT('%',#{param.industryCode},'%') or a.industry_name like concat('%',#{param.industryCode},'%'))
